metadata.division: DIVISION 8-3-11. EXCEPTIONS, VARIANCES, MODIFICATIONS, AND INTERPRETATIONS

content.title: 8-3-11-5. Reasonable accommodations.
content.summary: A.	Generally. The federal Fair Housing Amendments Act (42 U.S.C. § 3601, et seq., as amended) requires that local governments be prepared to make "reasonable accommodations" in order to permit housing for certain protected groups to occur in certain types of residential areas.
